issues.issue: In Lieu of Tax is its own receipt category under the user rules (2026-10-23), even when it is printed under Intergovernmental Revenues. It should be 'In Lieu of Tax'.
Category and detail_category should both be 'In Lieu of Tax' (the rules say 'each also as its detail_category').
The receipt line is categorised 'Ambulance Fees', but this detail line uses 'other charges for services'. 'ambulance/rescue fees' would match. The line may also include rural fire contract payments.
This is probably the public power district's in-lieu/5% payment (Public Power District Sales Tax or In Lieu of Tax) rather than a reimbursement. Review is already set. The same applies to detail[10].
Under the user's 2026-10-28 rule, recreation fees are their own category 'Recreation Fees'. detail[17] already uses recreation/pool/park fees, so the two are inconsistent.
